title: selaginella cordifolia
intro: Selaginella cordifolia, commonly known as the 'Tiger's Tail Fern' or 'Tiger's Tail', is a type of ancient, non-vascular, spore-producing plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, particularly in Southeast Asia and the Pacific Islands, due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella cordifolia include its ability to exhibit immunomodulatory, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic effects, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include saponins, flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been isolated and studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
